spans.s:
Śaulbāyana or Śaulvāyana, ‘descendant of Śulba,’ is the
patronymic of a teacher, Udaṅka.^1 According to the Śata-
patha Brāhmaṇa,^2 a Śaulbāyana was the Adhvaryu, or
sacrificing priest, of those who had Ayasthūṇa as Gṛhapati
(‘householder,’ the title of the sacrificer who has precedence at
a sattra, or sacrificial session).
1) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, vii. 4, 5, 4; 5, 4, 2; Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad, iv. 1,
2 Mādhyaṃdina.
2) xi. 4, 2, 17 et seq.
